conserved_invariants.reason: The new meaning is owned by Universal Intake Triage. Both substantive compressions route to that owner and preserve the same relation. The bootstrap changes only its source digest and generation date.

conserved_invariants.invariant: Exact subject, basis and evidence-bound causal diagnosis
conserved_invariants.reason: Frames test candidate diagnoses on one subject and basis with material variables, governing relations and evidence. Distinct frame labels alone provide no causal corroboration. The source distinguishes failure exposure from causal location.

conserved_invariants.invariant: Uncertainty, alternative causes and smallest sufficient lawful repair
conserved_invariants.reason: Unresolved alternatives remain explicit. The cited localization owner distinguishes a unique cause, jointly established frontier, unresolved alternatives and indeterminate evidence; minimality is causal and sufficient rather than arbitrary scope minimization.

The smallest sufficient applicable configuration remains governed by declared predicates and conjunction. Unknown applicability is not false; missing mandatory results and a constraint detected by one contributor cannot be discarded by aggregate agreement.

conserved_invariants.invariant: Claim-relative independence and proportionate actor topology
conserved_invariants.reason: No reviewer count or extra review round is prescribed. Required independence remains intact; the configuration may select one sufficient frame and actor. Different frame variables do not imply disjoint evidence or a new actor.

conserved_invariants.invariant: No authority or constitutional insufficiency inferred from diagnosis
conserved_invariants.reason: Diagnosis grants no repair effects and does not establish that governing meaning must change. Existing lawful change classes retain implementation-only correction and the upstream no-drift obligation.

conserved_invariants.reason: The Product still selects RC4, whose installed manifest verifies with no failures. The accepted frame-basis digest matches its admission record. RC2 source is the review subject, not replacement bootstrap authority.

A failure appearing in a frame treated as proof of cause within it: explicitly excluded.
Unresolved alternatives silently resolved or converted to a joint cause: preserved by text and localization owner.
Unknown applicability treated as false or a single-frame constraint waived by agreement: excluded by referenced frame law.
Triage made an always-on additional review or actor process: excluded by smallest sufficient configuration and no prescribed count/round.
